parameter.name: name
parameter.description: The Solace connection name to use.

parameter.name: target
parameter.description: INBOUND (default) replies to the message the inbound endpoint stashed. POLL replies to the message stashed by a poll with ackMode=CLIENT.

parameter.name: deliveryMode
parameter.description: Delivery mode: DIRECT, PERSISTENT, or NON_PERSISTENT (default: DIRECT).

parameter.name: messageType
parameter.description: Message type: TEXT, BYTES, or XML (default: TEXT). The body is written by the platform formatter of its content type, and this value selects the Solace message class. JSON has no message class of its own. Send it as TEXT or BYTES.

parameter.name: correlationId
parameter.description: Correlation ID for the reply message. If omitted, the correlation ID from the inbound request is echoed.

parameter.name: applicationMessageId
parameter.description: Application-defined message ID for the reply. If omitted, the application message ID from the inbound request is echoed.

parameter.name: senderId
parameter.description: Sender ID for the reply message.

parameter.name: userProperties
parameter.description: Custom user properties as a JSON array of objects, for example [{"region":"US"},{"priority":"high"}]. A string stays a string, an integer becomes a long, a decimal a double and a boolean a boolean. A receiver reads each one as the attribute userProp_ followed by the key.

parameter.name: dmqEligible
parameter.description: Whether the message is eligible for the Dead Message Queue (true/false).

parameter.name: elidingEligible
parameter.description: Whether the message is eligible for eliding (true/false).

parameter.name: expiration
parameter.description: Absolute message expiration time as a UTC epoch in milliseconds (0 means no expiration).

parameter.name: waitForAck
parameter.description: Whether to wait for the broker acknowledgement of a PERSISTENT or NON_PERSISTENT reply before returning. Default: true for PERSISTENT and NON_PERSISTENT. Ignored for DIRECT.

parameter.name: ackTimeout
parameter.description: Deadline in milliseconds for the connect, the send and the broker acknowledgement of the reply. Default: 10000.

parameter.name: responseVariable
parameter.description: The name of the variable to which the output should be stored.

parameter.name: overwriteBody
parameter.description: Replace the Message Body in Message Context with the response.
